run_sd_xl_inpaint_pipeline: run GaudiStableDiffusionXLInpaintPipeline to inpaint masked regions of an image using a text prompt on HPU
create_inpaint_pipeline_from_pretrained: create a GaudiStableDiffusionXLInpaintPipeline from a pretrained model like stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0 with fp16
run_unet_hpu_forward: run the unet_hpu method to perform a forward pass with HPU graph capture or direct inference
run_capture_replay_hpu_graph: run the capture_replay method to capture and replay HPU graphs for cached UNet inference
split_and_cat_tensors: split and concatenate tensors into batches with optional padding for classifier-free guidance
